caption_L1: Here a line diagram is named Median hourly earnings for full-time employees in the United Kingdom from 1997 to 2020 (in GBP). The x-axis plots Year using linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 while the y-axis plots Hourly pay in GBP as linear scale of range 0 to 15.
caption_L2L3: Hourly pay in the UK has increased every year during the period 1997 to 2020.  The largest increases happened during the period 1997 to 2009.  Since then the rate of increase has declined although it did increase more rapidly between 2015 and 2019.
